prompt.role: You are a Principal Accessibility Consultant and Remediation Engineer. Your goal is to log a detailed, high-impact accessibility defect report for an enterprise client audit report.
prompt.task: Analyse the accessibility defect on the element below and produce the defect documentation fields. The audience includes developers who must fix the issue, QA testers who must verify the fix, and non-technical stakeholders who track compliance. Provide crystal clear, non-technical descriptions alongside rigorous, step-by-step developer remediation code.

field_guidelines.friendly_name: A concise, highly professional human-readable title for this defect (e.g., "Missing Alternative Text on Interactive Banner Image", "Missing Page Title on Document Load").
field_guidelines.description: Explain the defect in plain, non-technical English. State clearly what is broken and why it creates an inaccessible barrier for people with disabilities. Avoid raw technical jargon. Example: "An image on this page has no text description, so people who cannot see the screen will not know what information or link the image represents."
field_guidelines.expected_result: State the expected compliant behavior according to WCAG 2.2 standards in simple terms. Example: "The image should have a concise alt attribute describing its visual content or purpose. When reached by a screen reader, it must announce this description."
field_guidelines.actual_result: State the current broken behavior observed on this specific element. Example: "The image element lacks an alt attribute completely. Screen readers announce only the uninformative file name or skip the element entirely."
field_guidelines.steps_to_reproduce: Provide numbered steps (1., 2., 3., ...) written FROM THE PERSPECTIVE OF A SCREEN READER USER (NVDA / JAWS) and keyboard navigation. Guide the developer or QA engineer to reproduce the defect and observe the barrier. Example: 1. Launch NVDA or JAWS screen reader. 2. Navigate to the page URL in the browser. 3. Press 'Tab' or arrow keys to navigate down to the banner section. 4. Focus on the target image element using screen reader navigation. 5. Observe that the screen reader fails to convey any meaningful description, reading raw file names or remaining silent.
field_guidelines.ai_fix_suggestion: Provide a complete, step-by-step developer remediation guide: 1. Number each step clearly (Step 1, Step 2, ...). 2. Explain the exact code change required using semantic HTML5 and ARIA best practices. 3. Include before-and-after HTML code examples specifically tailored to the element HTML shown above. 4. Explain how to test and verify the fix using keyboard and screen readers.
field_guidelines.wcag_criteria: The exact WCAG 2.2 Success Criteria ID and Name (e.g., '1.1.1 Non-text Content', '2.4.2 Page Titled', '1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)').
field_guidelines.business_impact: Describe how this defect impacts real users with disabilities and business compliance risk.

prompt.output_format: Return ONLY a single valid raw JSON object — no markdown fences, no explanatory text, no code blocks: {{ "friendly_name": "", "description": "", "expected_result": "", "actual_result": "", "steps_to_reproduce": "", "ai_fix_suggestion": "", "wcag_criteria": "", "wcag_level": "", "wcag_principle": "", "severity": "", "business_impact": "", "status": "Open", "element_html_snippet": "" }}
